name: TCL 85RM7L
summary: TCL 85RM7L ships with a Samba TV viewing tracker and TCL promos. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This TCL runs Google TV on Android 14 and ships with Samba TV, which tracks what is on screen, TCL analytics, log upload and account sign-in nags. It also has TCL Live FAST channels, content pushed to the home screen at boot, push messages and promos, retail demo apps, an e-manual and a cleaner. The ambient screensaver shows promos.

This is a clean-up only, and the stock Google TV home stays. The list was tested in five batches on a real unit. Home, YouTube, Live TV, the Input panel, four HDMI inputs, Chromecast, AirPlay, Miracast and Assistant all kept working. TidyTV saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Google Assistant and the remote's mic button
The USB media player and gallery
Live TV and the Input panel
Firmware updates through Google Play Services
notes: Turning off the TCL tweaks to the Google TV home may drop the red TV tile.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 85RM7L?
faq.a: Yes. Google Assistant and the remote service that carries the mic button are kept.
Yes. Chromecast, AirPlay and Miracast are kept and were tested.
Yes. Firmware updates come through Google Play Services, which this list does not touch.
